$comment: Raid and dungeon encounters for the R&Ds encounter guide. Every fact was checked against the listed sources (at least two per encounter) on the date below; 'notes' records where guides disagreed and which way this file went. Shields and champions are normal difficulty only; master-only ones are in notes. 'recommended' is what guides said, mostly written before the final sandbox; 'meta' is the subset of named weapons the planner rewards.

desert-perpetual.name: Iatros, Inward-Turned
desert-perpetual.tip: Moving Wyvern with a hard-to-hit crit; bring a forgiving, non-precision heavy (rockets/GL or Thunderlord) and something to clear Minotaurs/imps fast for the Chronon runner.

recommended.why: Non-precision burst on a constantly moving target (Shacknews)
Bolt charges; easy to land vs moving Wyvern; single-shot crit weapons struggle (LePrestore)
Strong with buffs, splash on big moving target (Shacknews)

recommended.weapon: Legend of Acrius / Outbreak Perfected + Divinity
recommended.why: Acrius with catalyst recommended; Outbreak only if Divinity cage is kept up (Shacknews)

desert-perpetual.notes: Name spelling Inward-Tuned vs Inward-Turned; chose Turned (Destinypedia + 3 others). No source lists elemental shields/champions on normal.

desert-perpetual.name: Agraios, Inherent
desert-perpetual.tip: Short ~15s burst windows on a big-headed sniper boss: bring precision heavy (LFR) plus snipers, and add clear for Hydras/Wyverns/sniper Hobgoblins.

recommended.weapon: Linear Fusion Rifles (Queenbreaker, Sleeper Simulant, legendary LFRs)
recommended.why: Large head crit, short burst windows (Shacknews, LePrestore)
Disabled in contest, expected strong afterwards (Shacknews)

desert-perpetual.notes: Portal count 5 (Shacknews/Grindout) vs 6 with 5 charged (LePrestore); irrelevant to loadout.

desert-perpetual.name: Epoptes, Lord of Quanta
desert-perpetual.tip: Lots of precise eye-shooting and a precision-heavy boss: bring an accurate primary, Thunderlord or a sniper, and add clear for Cyclops/Hydra side rooms.

recommended.why: Strongest per Shacknews; precision on respawning eyes

desert-perpetual.notes: Grindout counts 3 large Hydras, Destinypedia names two lens Hydras. Elements: Arc synergy suggested (Thundercrash, Thunderlord with Bolt Charge per LePrestore) but no elemental shields.

desert-perpetual.name: Koregos, The Worldline
desert-perpetual.tip: Very short final-stand burst on rotating eye crits with lasers and Arc pools to dodge; bring top precision burst (Thunderlord, Lord of Wolves, snipers) and save supers.

recommended.why: Precision heavy/special on eye crits (LePrestore, Shacknews)

desert-perpetual.notes: Koregos vs Keregos spelling; chose Koregos.

salvations-edge.name: Substratum
salvations-edge.tip: Two teams of three clear small rooms fast: bring close-mid add clear, Overload stun for the room champion, and burst for Tormentors/Subjugators.

recommended.why: Overload champion in a room (Backdash, Mein-MMO)

salvations-edge.notes: Shacknews says some third rooms have a Minotaur instead of a champion. Elements: Master adds Arc-shielded Supplicant Harpies and Void-shielded Minotaurs (Sportskeeda); normal has none documented. Master champions: Overload

salvations-edge.name: Herald of Finality (Dissipation)
salvations-edge.tip: Only marked players can damage the head in short windows: bring precision burst (Falling Guillotine-style heavy or Ergo Sum) plus Taken add clear.
salvations-edge.notes: Recs are 2024 contest-era; not re-verified for Monument of Triumph sandbox. Elements: Master: Solar-shielded Taken Revenant Knights (Sportskeeda). Void debuffs (weaken) recommended (Shacknews). Master champions: Overload

salvations-edge.name: Repository
salvations-edge.tip: Lane-based add clear across three floors: bring Unstoppable stun and burst for Tormentors and the Incendior at the end of each floor.

recommended.why: Unstoppable Incendior after each floor (Backdash); champion per room (Shacknews)

salvations-edge.notes: Champion type only from Backdash (Unstoppable Incendior); Shacknews says only 'Champion'. Sportskeeda says no master changes. Hive faction inferred from Incendior (Scorn?) - unverified. Master champions: Unstoppable

salvations-edge.name: Verity
salvations-edge.tip: Puzzle encounter with Knights and Ogres in tight rooms: bring close-range add clear and something for Unstoppable Ogres; DPS loadout irrelevant.
salvations-edge.notes: Shacknews mentions Unstoppable Ogres on normal; Sportskeeda lists Unstoppable Ogres as a Master change. Chose Unstoppable for both with low confidence. Elements: Master: Arc-shielded Hive Knights inside and outside (Sportskeeda). Master champions: Unstoppable

salvations-edge.name: Zenith (The Witness)
salvations-edge.tip: Sustained torso DPS while dodging hand attacks and jumping off before the slam: bring high-uptime non-precision heavy like grenade launchers plus buffs/debuffs.

recommended.why: Splash on torso, no crit needed; keep Radiant/Weaken (r/raidsecrets)

salvations-edge.notes: Crit spot unclear; Reddit says head immune, torso fine. Elements: Master: Void-shielded Scorn Chieftains (Sportskeeda).

crotas-end.name: The Abyss
crotas-end.tip: Dark-maze run ending in a hold-out vs Knights and Unstoppable Ogres: bring close-range add clear, an Unstoppable answer and mobility.

recommended.weapon: Unstoppable weapons (e.g. Leviathan's Breath, Devil's Ruin)

crotas-end.name: The Bridge
crotas-end.tip: Long bridge then indoor fights with endless Hive and Barrier champions: bring a long-range primary/sniper, an anti-Barrier option and close-range backup.
crotas-end.notes: Shacknews notes its guide reflects contest/master; Barrier presence on normal not independently confirmed.

crotas-end.name: Ir Yût, the Deathsinger
crotas-end.tip: Hard DPS check on a mostly stationary boss after killing Shieldsinger Wizards: bring top heavy DPS (rockets/Gjallarhorn, Leviathan's Breath, LFR) plus Divinity/Tractor.

recommended.why: Debuff/crit cage, boss doesn't move much (PCGamesN, Shacknews, Twinfinite)

crotas-end.notes: Arc Knight shields only in PCGamesN; Destructoid/Twinfinite mention no elemental shields. Elements: PCGamesN: Arc-shielded Blistered Knights (single source; not confirmed elsewhere).

crotas-end.name: Crota, Son of Oryx
crotas-end.tip: Swords break his shield, then short DPS with Tractor Cannon debuff and a sword/heavy; also need a precision weapon to shoot the Oversoul.

recommended.why: Strong DPS after weaken, sustain (Shacknews, Destructoid, ProGameGuides)

crotas-end.notes: Solar Wizard shields only in ProGameGuides; others silent. Elements: ProGameGuides: Solar-shielded Wizards (single source).

root-of-nightmares.name: Cataclysm
root-of-nightmares.tip: No boss: bring strong add clear plus something that kills Barrier Colossi and Tormentors fast to extend the Sweeping Terror timer.

recommended.weapon: Machine gun (Void / Volatile, e.g. Commemoration, Thunderlord)
recommended.why: Ammo economy for add clear, and fast Tormentor kills

recommended.weapon: SMG / Auto / Pulse (Funnelweb, Calus Mini-Tool, Osteo Striga)
recommended.why: Add clear while guarding the runners
Barrier Colossus spawns with each Tormentor wave

root-of-nightmares.notes: Timer extension per Tormentor: 30s (Windows Central, Boosting Ground) vs 35s (Shacknews). Elements: Void (Volatile) add clear is recommended. Master adds Solar shields on Centurions/Cabal. Master champions: Barrier

root-of-nightmares.name: Scission
root-of-nightmares.tip: No boss: you need add clear across three floors and an anti-Barrier option, and the buffed player must kill the Redolence enemies.

recommended.why: Still best for add clear, per HGG
Shooting launcher crystals across the gap
A Barrier Colossus appears near the end of each chain

root-of-nightmares.notes: None significant. Master adds Unstoppable Incendiors (Sportskeeda, Boosting Ground). Master champions: Barrier, Unstoppable

root-of-nightmares.name: Macrocosm
root-of-nightmares.tip: Burst DPS in short plate windows: rockets and LFRs that dump damage fast, plus Solar shield-breaking for the Centurions.

recommended.weapon: Rocket launchers (Gjallarhorn + Explosive Light / ALH legendaries)

root-of-nightmares.notes: Normal champions: Sportskeeda and Destinypedia say yellow-bar Colossi on normal, Barrier on master; Boosting Ground implies Barrier. Chose none on normal. Elements: Bring Solar for Honored Centurions (Destinypedia lists them as Solar-shielded on normal; Shacknews confirms Solar on master). Master champions: Barrier

root-of-nightmares.name: Nezarec, Final God of Pain
root-of-nightmares.tip: A roughly 30s damage window on a roaming boss: bring rockets, or Thunderlord with Divinity, and keep ammo for final stand.

recommended.why: Called very consistent and easy to use

recommended.weapon: Precision weapon for weak spots (e.g. Succession sniper)
recommended.why: For taunters shooting the shoulders and chest

root-of-nightmares.notes: Sources are 2023-era. No current-sandbox (2026) loadout source was found. Elements: No shield requirement. The Well of Radiance Solar Warlock is called near-essential. Master champions: Barrier

kings-fall.name: Hall of Souls
kings-fall.tip: Light add clear for Taken while relic runners open the portal; the encounter is low pressure on normal.
kings-fall.notes: Name: MISSING from tool list: opening relic/statue encounter before the Basilica (Destinypedia). Add it, or skip it if the tool ignores non-boss openers. Master shields: Shacknews says Arc on Captains; Sportskeeda says all three elements. Elements: Master only: Arc shields on Taken Captains. Master champions: Unstoppable, Overload

kings-fall.name: Basilica (Totems)
kings-fall.tip: No boss: you need fast Wizard and Knight kills plus an Unstoppable answer for the Ogres.
kings-fall.notes: None. Gamespot says these are the only champions in the normal raid. Elements: Master only: Solar shields on Hive Wizards. Master champions: Unstoppable

kings-fall.name: Warpriest
kings-fall.tip: A DPS check from inside the aura bubble, so bring precision heavy like LFRs; Solar helps on shielded Wizards.

recommended.why: Top precision damage inside the aura

kings-fall.notes: Normal Solar Wizards come from one source (Gamespot). Master Solar/Void shields are confirmed by two. Elements: Solar for Wizards (Gamespot, normal). Master adds Void on Taken Acolytes. Master champions: Barrier, Overload

kings-fall.name: Golgoroth
kings-fall.tip: A stationary boss shot in the belly from the pools, so sustained precision (LFR, slug shotgun) wins; gaze holders want a precise long-range gun.

recommended.why: Grabs the gaze in one shot, or debuffs

kings-fall.notes: Rotations before the wipe: Gamespot says six rounds; Shacknews says three full rotations (six marks). Same mechanic, counted differently. Elements: Master only: Solar on Wizards and Void on Taken Wizards. Master champions: Barrier

kings-fall.name: Daughters of Oryx
kings-fall.tip: Short burst windows from a ledge against a floating Daughter, so rockets (Gjallarhorn plus legendaries) are king; pack a ranged primary for snipers.

recommended.why: Clear adds at range from fixed plates

kings-fall.notes: ProGameGuides prefers LFR/Divinity; most others favour rockets. Chose rockets first. Elements: Master only: Arc on Taken Phalanxes and Captains. Master champions: Barrier

kings-fall.name: Oryx, the Taken King
kings-fall.tip: Short stagger windows on Oryx's chest from range, so bring LFRs or snipers plus Divinity; you also need fast Ogre and Knight kills.

recommended.why: Damage, and kills Light-Eater Knights at range

kings-fall.notes: Sources date from 2022. No current-sandbox meta source was found. Elements: Master only: Arc on Light-Eater Knights and the Vessel; Void on Taken Acolytes. Master champions: Overload

vow-of-the-disciple.name: Acquisition
vow-of-the-disciple.tip: No boss: bring add clear plus an Unstoppable answer, and burst (rockets) to delete Glyphkeepers and Abominations quickly.
vow-of-the-disciple.notes: Destinypedia lists no normal champions or shields. Shacknews, Windows Central, TheGamer and DestinyTracker all report Unstoppable on normal, so I kept it. The Solar Glyphkeeper shield on normal comes from Windows Central only. Elements: Windows Central reports Solar shields on Scorn Glyphkeepers (normal). Master adds Solar on Taken Knights. Master champions: Unstoppable, Overload

vow-of-the-disciple.name: The Caretaker
vow-of-the-disciple.tip: Short 10s plate windows on a walking boss, so you need high burst like LFRs or rockets; good ammo economy helps too.

recommended.why: Ideal per Shacknews; Triple Tap/Field Prep rolls

vow-of-the-disciple.notes: Blueberries (challenge guide) says an Overload Hobgoblin spawns at each offering. Destinypedia says Overload Hobgoblins replace Taken Vandals only on master. Chose master only for Overload. Master champions: Overload

vow-of-the-disciple.name: Exhibition
vow-of-the-disciple.tip: No boss: you need roaming add clear and an Overload answer for the Taken Hobgoblins, while racing the Terminal Resonance timer.

recommended.why: Add clear; Gjallarhorn for long-range burst

vow-of-the-disciple.notes: Blueberries says both Overload and Unstoppable. Shacknews, TheGamer, Windows Central and the Destinypedia enemy list say Overload. Chose Overload for normal. Elements: Master only: Void shields on non-champion Taken Hobgoblins and Solar on Taken Knights. Master champions: Overload, Unstoppable

vow-of-the-disciple.name: Rhulk, Disciple of the Witness
vow-of-the-disciple.tip: Rhulk moves and kicks during damage, so bring LFRs or rockets with Divinity and keep supers for final stand.

recommended.why: Keeps a 30% debuff and crit bubble on a moving boss

vow-of-the-disciple.notes: Blueberries says Glyphkeepers spawn as Unstoppable/Overload champions. Destinypedia says Glyphkeepers become champions only on master. Chose none on normal. Master champions: Unstoppable, Overload

vault-of-glass.name: Confluxes
vault-of-glass.tip: Pure add-clear defence: bring strong area damage and an Overload option, and save heavy/supers for Wyverns before they sacrifice.

recommended.weapon: Rocket / grenade launcher (Witherhoard, Anarchy, Salvager's Salvo)
recommended.why: Fast Wyvern kills and area control

vault-of-glass.notes: Normal-mode Overload Minotaurs stated by Shacknews, PC Gamer and boosting-ground; Dexerto silent. Master champion set only partly sourced (Sportskeeda names Barrier). Elements: Void helps against void-shielded Praetorians; only shield type in the raid per PC Gamer. Master champions: Overload, Barrier

vault-of-glass.name: Oracles
vault-of-glass.tip: Precision/explosive weapons that can kill Oracles instantly at range in the right order, plus something for Hobgoblin snipers.
vault-of-glass.notes: Master Barrier Hobgoblins only from boosting-ground (single source). Master champions: Barrier

vault-of-glass.name: The Templar
vault-of-glass.tip: Precision burst on the Templar's crit spot during a short window after the Relic breaks its shield; block its teleport to extend damage.

recommended.why: High precision burst on stationary crit

vault-of-glass.notes: Crit described as 'nose' (Shacknews) vs 'eye' (boosting-ground); same spot. Master champions: Overload

vault-of-glass.name: Gorgons' Labyrinth
vault-of-glass.tip: Stealth maze with no combat; loadout barely matters beyond a heavy weapon in case a Gorgon must die.

vault-of-glass.name: Gatekeepers
vault-of-glass.tip: Heavy add clear with burst for Gatekeeper Hydras and Wyverns plus an Overload answer; Relic handles Praetorian shields.
vault-of-glass.notes: Dexerto calls side Minotaurs 'immune' (Relic) while others note Overload Minotaurs; both appear. Master champions: Overload, Barrier

vault-of-glass.name: Atheon, Time's Conflux
vault-of-glass.tip: Short 30-second Time's Vengeance burst from the central platform: highest burst heavy plus supers; Oracle-killing weapon for the away team.

recommended.why: Precision damage on a still boss

deep-stone-crypt.name: Crypt Security
deep-stone-crypt.tip: Mostly add clear and fuse damage; bring an Overload option for Captains and a heavy that hits fuses well.

recommended.weapon: Xenophage / machine gun (Fourth Horseman per guide)

deep-stone-crypt.notes: Master DSC champion set not found in sources; left empty. Elements: Only Void shields in the raid (PC Gamer, Prima).

deep-stone-crypt.name: Atraks-1, Fallen Exo
deep-stone-crypt.tip: Coordinated close-range burst on clones that vanish shortly after being damaged; swords and high-burst weapons shine.
deep-stone-crypt.notes: Champions here not explicitly placed by sources; raid-wide Overload inferred.

deep-stone-crypt.name: Rapture
deep-stone-crypt.tip: No boss damage; strong add clear and survivability while carrying nuclear cores, with Overload cover.
deep-stone-crypt.notes: Name: Conflated: 'Rapture' (Taniks, Reborn / Prevent Europa's Destruction, nuke-core encounter) is the real 3rd encounter; 'The Descent' is the jumping puzzle after it. Suggest renaming to 'Rapture'. Shacknews orders Descent before Taniks Reborn; PC Gamer orders chamber then Europa defence. In-game, Rapture precedes the Descent jump. Elements: Void for shields.

deep-stone-crypt.name: Taniks, the Abomination
deep-stone-crypt.tip: Precision DPS from between the rings with periodic knockbacks, then a teleporting final stand that rewards snipers and burst.
deep-stone-crypt.notes: Sword viability unclear: Prima says sword for adds only. Elements: Void-shielded Captains in add phase.

garden-of-salvation.name: Evade the Consecrated Mind
garden-of-salvation.tip: Moving add clear with Overload for Minotaurs and long-range answers for Cyclopes and Hydras.
garden-of-salvation.notes: Grindout also mentions Barrier here; Shacknews/PowerPyx/GameSpot only Overload. Chose Overload. Elements: Void secondary helps on void-shielded Minotaurs.

garden-of-salvation.name: Summon the Consecrated Mind
garden-of-salvation.tip: Relay defence: Anti-Barrier for Hobgoblins, area add clear and burst for Angelic Hydras.

garden-of-salvation.name: Consecrated Mind, Sol Inherent
garden-of-salvation.tip: Precision sniping of eyes and the retreating weak point; snipers and precision burst over rockets.
garden-of-salvation.notes: No source names champions here; left empty.

garden-of-salvation.name: Sanctified Mind, Sol Inherent
garden-of-salvation.tip: Precision damage on a hovering boss while staying alive on breaking platforms; snipers and healing support.
garden-of-salvation.notes: Phase count: Grindout says one phase in current sandbox; GameSpot 2-3 phases at launch.

last-wish.name: Kalli, the Corrupted
last-wish.tip: Burst DPS in the center between wipe mechanics; boss teleports between plates during the plate phase.

last-wish.name: Shuro Chi, the Corrupted
last-wish.tip: Short burst windows after shield break; strong add clear and a Well for the final floor.
last-wish.notes: Fandom mentions Fallen Captains; Shacknews says Taken Captain. Chose Taken only.

last-wish.name: Morgeth, the Spirekeeper
last-wish.tip: Sustained precision on Morgeth's back crit from a safe position; sniper and boss DPS weapon.

last-wish.name: The Vault
last-wish.tip: No boss: burst Might of Riven Knights before they reach locks; shotguns, fusions and heavy freely.

last-wish.name: Riven of a Thousand Voices
last-wish.tip: Burst rockets/precision into Riven's mouth during short windows; cluster-bomb rockets are classic.

last-wish.name: Queenswalk
last-wish.tip: No boss: keep the carrier alive; fast add clear in the bubble.

equilibrium.name: The Harvester
equilibrium.tip: Add-clear fight with no boss DPS: bring strong add clear for Cabal waves and some burst for Behemoth walkers; stay off drop-pod landing spots.

recommended.why: Used in solo-flawless builds for the whole dungeon
General dungeon loadout pick for add clear and heavy targets

equilibrium.notes: Name: Mostly ok. Guides (Grindout, ProGameTalk, Kyber's Corner, GameRant) call it 'Harvester'; the in-game objective per Destinypedia is 'Defeat the Barant Imperium Forces' (the Harvester is the ship you board after it). Suggest 'The Harvester (Barant Imperium Forces)'. Name: guides say 'Harvester', in-game objective 'Defeat the Barant Imperium Forces'. Shacknews treats it as a pure add clear; NoobFeed describes generator-shield walls. No source lists champions.

equilibrium.name: Harrow, Dredgen Apprentice
equilibrium.tip: Melee-range gladiator boss with short ~30 s windows after shield breaks: bring high-burst heavy and a close-range option; he charges a lethal AoE explosion so keep cover nearby.

recommended.weapon: Praxic Blade, Legend of Acrius, Parasite
recommended.why: High burst damage for short windows (Shacknews, Grindout)
Close-range boss; NoobFeed recommends close-range weapons

equilibrium.notes: Sources differ on shield removal detail (pits vs Arc coils vs generator) but agree on burst/close-range. Champions not mentioned anywhere.

equilibrium.name: Dredgen Sere
equilibrium.tip: Final boss with burst windows after orb mechanics: bring high-burst heavy (Parasite/rockets) plus a precision weapon to shoot his hands and stop 'Face Your Death'; stay back from his opening slam.

recommended.weapon: Finality's Auger, Mint Retrograde, sniper rifles

equilibrium.notes: Timesaver.gg names the final boss 'Dredgen Bael' (error; ignored). Phase length unknown. Elements: Well of Radiance recommended by multiple guides (Solar support).

sundered-doctrine.name: Solve the Riddle
sundered-doctrine.tip: Puzzle encounter with Subjugators and Grims and no boss DPS: bring solid add clear and something to burst down Subjugators and a possible Tormentor.

sundered-doctrine.name: Zoetic Lockset
sundered-doctrine.tip: Long, high-health DPS on four stationary Shriekers: bring sustained precision heavy (LFRs, Sleeper) or Grand Overture and ammo support.

sundered-doctrine.name: Kerrev, the Erased
sundered-doctrine.tip: Mobile, hard-hitting Dread boss that suspends players: bring precision heavy (LFR/rockets), Divinity for an easy crit bubble, and avoid melee heavy weapons.

recommended.weapon: Rocket launchers / Bait and Switch grenade launchers

sundered-doctrine.notes: Grindout says light 'lie' symbols; Destinypedia says choose truth or lie side. Mechanic detail only; no loadout impact. Elements: Kerrev's attacks apply Strand debuffs; Strand resistance mods advised (Deltia's).

vespers-host.name: Activation
vespers-host.tip: Fallen add-clear and nuke-core running ending on a tanky Brig: bring strong add clear and save heavy/Super for the final Brig.
vespers-host.notes: Encounter naming varies (Activation / Reboot the Station).

vespers-host.name: Raneiks Unified
vespers-host.tip: Servitor boss that splits into numbered pieces with ~25 s windows: bring AoE burst (Parasite, grenade launchers, Dragon's Breath) and Solar ignition/Consecration.

recommended.why: Fast big damage (Shacknews, Sportskeeda with Concussive Reload)

vespers-host.notes: None. Elements: Solar (Consecration Titan, Song of Flame ignitions) favored; Void resistance for suppressor carrier (Sportskeeda).

vespers-host.name: The Corrupted Puppeteer
vespers-host.tip: Teleporting boss with arena-wide lightning: bring mobile sustained damage (Grand Overture, grenade launchers, Whisper) and keep moving or sit in Well.

recommended.weapon: Bait and Switch grenade launchers / Edge Transit

vespers-host.notes: Name: CORRECTION: current list says 'Insurrection Prime' - wrong. The final boss is 'The Corrupted Puppeteer' (a corrupted Atraks), confirmed by Destinypedia, light.gg ('Corrupted Puppeteer defeated'), Shacknews, Sportskeeda, PCGamesN. Number of core deposits differs (two vs three) between Shacknews and PCGamesN; not loadout-relevant. Elements: Arc resistance helps against lightning strikes (Sportskeeda).

warlords-ruin.name: Rathil, First Broken Knight of Fikrul
warlords-ruin.tip: Grounded, low-health boss with an easy crit: snipers, shotguns or swords all work; bring precision to shoot Acolyte Eyes from your cage.
warlords-ruin.notes: Shacknews says cleansed totems turn Stasis; others say wish-empowered. Cosmetic.

warlords-ruin.name: Locus of Wailing Grief
warlords-ruin.tip: Stationary Taken Ogre damaged only while standing by lit braziers: bring rockets/Leviathan's Breath or snipers and move brazier to brazier.

warlords-ruin.name: Hefnd's Vengeance, Blighted Chimaera
warlords-ruin.tip: Floating boss across island platforms: avoid shotguns/melee; bring rockets (Apex Predator) and snipers, plus add clear for Blights and eyes.
warlords-ruin.notes: Only one source (Shacknews) gives weapon picks; Tracker recommends Orpheus Rig Tether Hunter.

ghosts-of-the-deep.name: Hive Ritual
ghosts-of-the-deep.tip: Pure add-clear and runs: kill Ogres, Lightbearer Wizards and the Veilweaver Wizard fast, then deliver Vestiges. Bring strong add clear plus something for an Ogre.

recommended.why: Constant Hive squads and Thrall between Vestige runs
Soulfire Binder Ogres and Veilweaver Wizard gate progress
Master swaps Ogres for Unstoppable Ogres

ghosts-of-the-deep.notes: Name: Wiki/guides call it 'Hive Ritual' (Destinypedia, Kyber) or 'Hive Ritual Disrupted' (Shacknews, Overgear). Suggest 'Hive Ritual'. No source lists normal-mode champions; assumed none (normal dungeons generally lack champions). Master Unstoppable Ogres from Shacknews only. Master champions: Unstoppable

ghosts-of-the-deep.name: Ecthar, Shield of Savathûn
ghosts-of-the-deep.tip: Underwater symbol runs plus Lucent Hive above water; damage Ecthar while standing in the Wellkeeper's pool for Piercing Light. Bring damage resist, add clear and a solid burst/LFR heavy.

recommended.why: Takes big chunks during the window
Prima lists swords for big damage while he is close
Bonus DoT; also used in a cheese strat
Removes his shield in one shot

ghosts-of-the-deep.notes: Shacknews advises against rockets in the pool; Prima's team used Gjallarhorn. Recommendations are from launch-era (2023) sandbox, not verified for the 2026 sandbox. Elements: Shacknews recommends Arc Resistance mods; Well of Radiance 'almost mandatory'. No elemental enemy shields reported. Master champions: Unstoppable

ghosts-of-the-deep.name: Šimmumah ur-Nokru
ghosts-of-the-deep.tip: Final boss flies around constantly; bring precision/tracking heavy (LFR, tracking rockets, Leviathan's Breath) and survivability for a long arena fight with a respawning Vorlog.

recommended.why: Massive damage, recommended by two guides

recommended.weapon: Rocket Launcher with Tracking Module / Gjallarhorn
recommended.why: Hits a moving boss while you keep moving

ghosts-of-the-deep.notes: Master Barrier Knights and Vorlog Arc shield only from Shacknews (single source). Weapon advice is 2023-era. Elements: Arc Resistance mods suggested; on Master bring Arc for Vorlog's Arc shield. Master champions: Barrier

spire-of-the-watcher.name: Ascend the Spire
spire-of-the-watcher.tip: Arc-node puzzle while Vex harass from ledges; bring a precise weapon for nodes and a ranged weapon for Harpies, Hobgoblins and Cyclops.

recommended.why: Hit nodes and Harpies/Hobgoblins at range without splash

spire-of-the-watcher.notes: Name: Encounter is 'Ascend the Spire' (Destinypedia, Vaexil, Shacknews); preceded by the 'Reestablish Power' opening puzzle. Suggest rename to 'Ascend the Spire'. Vaexil says Master adds Barrier as well as Overload and Arc+Void shields; Shacknews/Paracausality/Destinypedia only confirm Overload Minotaurs and Arc Harpies. Elements: Master: Arc weapons for Arc-shielded Harpies (Vaexil also mentions Void shields on Master). Master champions: Overload

spire-of-the-watcher.name: Akelous, the Siren's Current
spire-of-the-watcher.tip: Shred 12 glowing eyes fast (SMG), then dump burst damage on the exposed core as it drifts back to center; stay on the centerline to avoid the knockback blast.

recommended.why: Best on the core precision point
Works on a retreating core; tracking helps

spire-of-the-watcher.notes: None material. Elements: Master: Arc for Harpy shields. Master champions: Overload

spire-of-the-watcher.name: Persys, Primordial Ruin
spire-of-the-watcher.tip: Lure the Wyvern into the reactor, purge its shield, then hit its small core while it advances on you; bring reliable Hydra/Supplicant clear and boss damage usable while moving.
spire-of-the-watcher.notes: Weapon picks from 2022-23 guides; no current-sandbox source. Elements: Concussive Dampener and Void resistance suggested (Paracausality). Master champions: Overload

duality.name: Nightmare of Gahlran
duality.tip: Timed realm-swapping: kill Bellkeepers, Standard Bearers and Visions quickly, then burst Gahlran before the Nightmare timer ends; bring high burst damage and range for Psion snipers.

recommended.why: Burst in a short timed window

duality.notes: Master Unstoppable Incendiors from Shacknews; Boosting-ground says Master has Barrier+Unstoppable overall. Elements: Void for Bellkeepers on Master. Master champions: Unstoppable

duality.name: Unlock the Vault
duality.tip: Three untimed mini-boss Nightmares under heavy Cabal pressure (Phalanxes, Colossi); prioritize add clear and survivability over burst.

recommended.why: Close damage on mini-bosses and majors

duality.notes: Name: In-game/wiki name is 'Unlock the Vault' (three Nightmares: Ka'hok, Emonut, Uroa). Suggest rename. Elemental shields on Nightmares only from boosting-ground (low). Master Barrier Colossus confirmed by Shacknews and Destinypedia. Elements: One guide says the three Nightmares have Arc, Void, Solar shields in order; not confirmed elsewhere (Dotesports only calls it a 'nightmarish shield'). Master champions: Barrier

duality.name: Nightmare of Caiatl
duality.tip: Damage only in ~10s stun windows at each bell with Waking Resonance; bring burst heavy (LFR/rockets) and clear six Bellkeepers fast.
duality.notes: Solar Centurion shields only from Sportskeeda. Elements: Master: Void for Bellkeepers, Solar for Centurions (Sportskeeda). Master champions: Barrier

grasp-of-avarice.name: Phry'zhia the Insatiable
grasp-of-avarice.tip: Stationary Ogre boss: farm and deposit engrams, then burst its head. Ideal for LFRs, rockets or a sword.

recommended.why: Top pick in the Season of the Lost era

grasp-of-avarice.notes: Deposit count varies by source (20/25/40). Master Barrier Knights only from Shacknews. Elements: Solar resistance for the Ogre beam (boosting-ground). Master champions: Barrier

grasp-of-avarice.name: Fallen Shield
grasp-of-avarice.tip: No boss damage: clear Fallen on islands, deposit engrams, kill Servitors and launch them into the shield. All about add clear.

recommended.why: Heavy add clear; LFRs/rockets/swords not needed

grasp-of-avarice.notes: Shacknews mentions Master Overload Captains and Anti-Barrier Servitors; single source. Master champions: Overload, Barrier

grasp-of-avarice.name: Captain Avarokk, the Covetous
grasp-of-avarice.tip: Kill the Shank sniper and invisible Marauder lieutenants first, deposit 50-60 engrams, then burst Avarokk in a short (~30s) window.
grasp-of-avarice.notes: Deposit count 50 (PC Gamer) vs 60 (Shacknews, Destinypedia). Master Anti-Barrier Servitors only from Shacknews. Elements: Arc and Sniper resistance mods (boosting-ground). Master champions: Barrier

prophecy.name: Phalanx Echo
prophecy.tip: Bring a Psion/add-clear primary, something to kill Knight Echoes without overkilling, and a burst heavy (sword or rockets) for short damage windows while avoiding his shield-bash knockback.

recommended.why: Cited for one-phase burst with Well of Radiance

recommended.weapon: Linear Fusion Rifle or Rocket Launcher

recommended.why: Psions multiply if not cleared fast

prophecy.notes: No source lists champions or elemental shields; set empty. Vaexil says Prophecy has no current Master version; champions may still come via custom-difficulty modifiers.

prophecy.name: Hexahedron
prophecy.tip: Long-range precision for Hobgoblin snipers plus steady Psion clear; save heavy/super for the two Centurion Echoes at the end.

recommended.why: Named for cube adds and Centurions

prophecy.notes: Shacknews says kill Hobgoblins to spawn Knights; timesaver says 'Snipers' - same enemy. Recommendations are older-sandbox.

prophecy.name: Kell Echo
prophecy.tip: Clear Psions/Knights and kill an Ogre per plate, then chase the boss down a hallway staying inside his aura; bring heavy that works while moving and something for Hobgoblin snipers.

recommended.why: Strong DPS while staying in the aura

recommended.weapon: Whisper of the Worm / Izanagi's Burden / Leviathan's Breath
recommended.why: Long-range power precision while boss moves
Alternative if swords get you stomped

prophecy.notes: Shacknews says stay OUT of the boss AoE; Destinypedia, Overgear and Timesaver say stay INSIDE the aura to avoid Dark Entropy - chose inside. Elements: GamerGuideHub suggests Void/Solar generally for Prophecy; no shield-driven element need.

pit-of-heresy.name: Necropolis
pit-of-heresy.tip: The Hive sword relic does the disciple damage; your loadout needs heavy (rockets/GL) for the Revenant Ogres and good add clear for tower interiors.

recommended.why: Kill Revenant Ogres (Shrieker room) fast before taking the sword in

pit-of-heresy.notes: No guide mentions champions; Vaexil (verified Aug 2026) says champions/shields depend on the live activity card. Solar Wizard shield only from Destinypedia enemy infobox. Elements: Revenant Wizards carry Solar shields per Destinypedia enemy page (single source).

pit-of-heresy.name: Tunnels of Despair
pit-of-heresy.tip: Mostly navigation and avoidance; a reliable primary for Heretical Knights and Thrall in side caves is all you need.

recommended.why: Kill 3 Knights for Void orbs quickly while Ogres patrol

pit-of-heresy.notes: Name: MISSING from tool list: real objective between Necropolis and Chamber of Suffering (avoid unkillable Harrowing Pariah Ogres, dunk 3 Knight orbs at doors) None on structure; 5 sources list it as an encounter. Optional for the tool (low loadout relevance).

pit-of-heresy.name: Chamber of Suffering
pit-of-heresy.tip: Wave defense: bring strong add clear plus a long-range precision or heavy option to delete balcony Boomer Knights and orb Knights from the totem plate.

recommended.weapon: Sniper / Linear Fusion Rifle / Rocket Launcher / Xenophage
recommended.why: Kill Boomer Knights fast from the plate

recommended.weapon: Trinity Ghoul / incandescent or voltshot primary

pit-of-heresy.name: The Harrow
pit-of-heresy.tip: Mostly platforming; a sniper/LFR to pick off the Solar-shielded Ritualist Wizards from safe ground helps most.
pit-of-heresy.notes: Name: Official name is 'The Harrow' (jumping-puzzle/trap section with 3 Malevolent Ritualist Wizards) Shield element from one source only. Elements: Malevolent Ritualists have a Solar absorption shield (Destinypedia infobox; not mentioned by guides).

pit-of-heresy.name: Zulmak, Instrument of Torment
pit-of-heresy.tip: Sword-centric fight: the relic does the disciple work, then you DPS inside the small ring around the crystal, so bring a heavy sword (or rockets/LFR) and add clear for Cursed Thrall.

recommended.why: Must stand in ring next to boss; swords maximize damage
Safer ranged DPS within the ring

pit-of-heresy.notes: Destinypedia's Zulmak page calls the Knight disciple 'Vanquisher' vs 'Might' elsewhere (naming only). No champions listed anywhere.

shattered-throne.name: Erebus
shattered-throne.tip: Long-range primary/special for Hobgoblin snipers on ledges plus special/heavy for Taken Architect minibosses.
shattered-throne.notes: Name: MISSING from tool list: first real encounter (symbol-labyrinth with Labyrinth Architect minibosses, then Asterion, Set Apart) Grindout describes Erebus with a 'Petitioner's Mark' mechanic (wrong, that is Vorgeth) and gives inconsistent symbol counts; ignored.

shattered-throne.name: The Descent
shattered-throne.tip: Bring a long-range weapon to kill Ogres the moment they spawn (their blasts knock you off) and add clear for the Thrallway.

recommended.why: Kill Ogres and Hobgoblins at range

shattered-throne.notes: Name: MISSING from tool list (optional): traversal fight - sniper hallway, Taken Ogre catwalk room, endless Shadow Thrall hall, then cross the chasm None.

shattered-throne.name: Vorgeth, the Boundless Hunger
shattered-throne.tip: Kill four Void-shielded Keeper Wizards at range, then burst the Taken Ogre in a ~30s window while someone shoots down his Axion Darts.

recommended.why: One-phase with Ward of Dawn; self-heal

recommended.weapon: Linear Fusion / Rocket Launcher / Whisper of the Worm
recommended.why: Burst DPS; Whisper also handles darts

shattered-throne.notes: Name: Full name is 'Vorgeth, the Boundless Hunger' Grindout recommends Queensbreaker/Lord of Wolves and says orbs go on plates (dated/unreliable). Void shield from Destinypedia only. Elements: Keepers of Petitions carry Void shields (Destinypedia enemy page); a Void special/primary speeds Keeper kills.

shattered-throne.name: Dûl Incaru, the Eternal Return
shattered-throne.tip: Clear Psion swarms fast, kill the three Fatesmith Knights with high damage, then dump heavy on Dûl Incaru within the 45s Finite Thought timer and break any immunity crystal.

recommended.why: Heavy DPS on Knights and boss

shattered-throne.notes: Name: Spelled 'Dûl Incaru, the Eternal Return' in game (ASCII 'Dul' fine). Preceded by an 'Ascend' tower-climb traversal (Wizards, Captains, Hobgoblins) not tracked. Ludo.guide describes a damage-broken shield, healing Knights and teleport to center (contradicts Destinypedia/TheGamer/boosting-ground; discarded). Grindout says crystals wipe the team; chose Destinypedia's Knight-immunity crystal.
